    if len(data) > 4096:
        data = data[:4096]
    return data

import random
import string

def _rand_ident(rng, min_len=3, max_len=12):
    first = rng.choice(string.ascii_uppercase)
    rest_chars = string.ascii_letters + string.digits + "-"
    rest_len = rng.randint(min_len-1, max_len-1)
    rest = ''.join(rng.choice(rest_chars) for _ in range(rest_len))
    return first + rest

def _rand_number_oid(rng, max_arcs=12):
    # Build numeric dotted OID starting with enterprises (1.3.6.1.4.1)
    base = [1,3,6,1,4,1]
    # random enterprise id and optional tail
    ent = rng.randint(1, 200000)
    oid = base + [ent]
    extra = rng.randint(0, max(0, max_arcs - len(oid)))
    for _ in range(extra):
        oid.append(rng.randint(0, 100000))
    return '.'.join(str(x) for x in oid)

def _module_header(rng, name):
    # Optionally include explicit DEFINITIONS/BEGIN formatting variants
    return f"{name} DEFINITIONS ::= BEGIN\n"

def _imports_section(rng):
    # Provide common imports to keep parser happy across variants
    lines = []
    # Sometimes provide a full list including macros/types used in simple objects
    common_imports = [
        ("OBJECT-TYPE", "SNMPv2-SMI"),
        ("MODULE-IDENTITY", "SNMPv2-SMI"),
        ("OBJECT-IDENTITY", "SNMPv2-SMI"),
        ("enterprises", "SNMPv2-SMI"),
        ("Integer32", "SNMPv2-SMI"),
        ("MODULE-COMPLIANCE", "SNMPv2-CONF"),
        ("OBJECT-GROUP", "SNMPv2-CONF"),
        ("DisplayString", "SNMPv2-TC"),
    ]
    # Choose a subset but always include enterprises and OBJECT-TYPE to be safe
    ensure = {"enterprises", "OBJECT-TYPE"}
    chosen = set()
    for sym, mod in common_imports:
        if sym in ensure or rng.random() < 0.6:
            lines.append(f"    {sym} FROM {mod}")
            chosen.add(sym)
    # Format IMPORTS block
    if not lines:
        lines.append("    enterprises FROM SNMPv2-SMI")
        lines.append("    OBJECT-TYPE FROM SNMPv2-SMI")
    imports = ",\n".join(lines) + ";\n"
    return "IMPORTS\n" + imports

def _enterprise_assignment(rng, modname, label=None):
    if label is None:
        label = _rand_ident(rng)
    ent = rng.randint(1000, 200000)
    return f"{label} OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= {{ enterprises {ent} }}\n", label, ent

def _object_identity(rng, parent_label):
    name = _rand_ident(rng)
    subid = rng.randint(1, 100)
    return (
        f"{name} OBJECT-IDENTITY\n"
        f"    STATUS      current\n"
        f"    DESCRIPTION \"A test identity.\"\n"
        f"    ::= {{ {parent_label} {subid} }}\n\n"
    )

def _object_type_scalar(rng, parent_label):
    name = _rand_ident(rng)
    subid = rng.randint(1, 100)
    syntax = rng.choice(["Integer32", "OCTET STRING", "DisplayString"])
    access = rng.choice(["read-only", "read-write"])  # legacy forms often accepted
    status = rng.choice(["current", "deprecated"])
    descr = "Simple scalar object for fuzz."
    return (
        f"{name} OBJECT-TYPE\n"
        f"    SYNTAX      {syntax}\n"
        f"    MAX-ACCESS  {access}\n"
        f"    STATUS      {status}\n"
        f"    DESCRIPTION \"{descr}\"\n"
        f"    ::= {{ {parent_label} {subid} }}\n\n"
    )

def _trap_definition(rng, parent_label):
    # Use SNMPv2 style notification as a valid construct without heavy IMPORTS if not used
    name = _rand_ident(rng)
    subid = rng.randint(101, 200)
    return (
        f"{name} OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= {{ {parent_label} {subid} }}\n\n"
    )

def _module_identity(rng, parent_label):
    name = _rand_ident(rng)
    subid = rng.randint(201, 300)
    return (
        f"{name} OBJECT IDENTIFIER ::= {{ {parent_label} {subid} }}\n\n"
    )

def _end_section():
    return "END\n"

def _build_mib(rng):
    modname = _rand_ident(rng)
    parts = []
    parts.append(_module_header(rng, modname))
    parts.append(_imports_section(rng))
    ent_assign, ent_label, _ = _enterprise_assignment(rng, modname)
    parts.append(ent_assign)

    # Define a small tree under enterprise
    # 1) One OBJECT-IDENTITY
    parts.append(_object_identity(rng, ent_label))
    # 2) One OBJECT-TYPE scalar
    parts.append(_object_type_scalar(rng, ent_label))
    # 3) Additional OID nodes
    for _ in range(rng.randint(1, 3)):
        parts.append(_trap_definition(rng, ent_label))
    # 4) Module identity as plain OID assignment to keep things light
    parts.append(_module_identity(rng, ent_label))

    parts.append(_end_section())
    return ''.join(parts)


def generate(seed: int) -> bytes:
    """
    Generate a valid ASN.1 MIB module text suitable for Net-SNMP read_mib() parser.
    The returned bytes are <= 4096 and vary with the seed while remaining well-formed.
    """
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    # Build multiple variants and pick one to increase diversity while keeping validity
    mib_text = _build_mib(rng)
    data = mib_text.encode('ascii', errors='strict')
    # Ensure size constraint
    if len(data) > 4096:
        data = data[:4096]
    return data
